facts.fact: Lands Permanent Secretary Dorcas Wagima Okalany said landowners' photographs and national identification numbers are now in the digital land database, reducing forgery and impersonation.

UGA.note: Nothing on the ID system's own robustness.

facts.fact: Lands Permanent Secretary Okalany said the digitalised system handles land acquisition, transfer, surveying and planning, with titles processed within ten days when documents are in order.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development

facts.fact: Lands Permanent Secretary Okalany said more than 1.5 million land titles have already been digitised under the new system.
Okalany said landowners can verify their land status online or through the ministry's mobile application for 10,000 Ugandan shillings.
